content: Nagaya Polonae Yisasi Kalaisi kema nehua yateti navaleya kina hunataya kanogina nagaiene Timoti nenafuene taagaya mani avona kaetaa Filemoniga nelamue taagaiene Yisasi aliyama nealina kanogino taahau taayamopafi laahaigetaa nehue.

Taagaya Apiyaga taasatiamogaleene Akipusigaene Yisasi keleti taagaiene ati vaya kana huta tuma nehuna kanomoga Yisasi kema havigahe kagai nopima melitalu nehaya veamogamifeene mani avona kaetaa nelamamue.
Anumaya Koti, Nelafaene Yisasi Kalaisi Anumayatimoene kayone hisaa yaene tamaipa alino falu hulamatesae.
Filemonina kanale auavaamoa Polo aipamona alino muse hutene.

Kagaifena Anumayatimoa Yisasina agua amitafa humainea kano maineno mukia Yisasina amakua amiya veafena hau ayamopafi nehaiye. huya nahapaigena havua yafena nagaya kagaifena nagesa havi havi huna Anumayamotega kagai kagia ayena havinegoe.

Kagaya Filemoniga Yisasife havika kagupi malenana nenafuga mainanagena nagaya Anumaya Kotitega mage huna havinegoe Kalaisia mukia yana kanale yama taminea yafena havilama huta havisune. huna havinegoe.

E, nenafugae mukiamoya Yisasina amakuama aminaya veafena kahau kayamopafima negahaiya yamoa ani veamogamina amaipamoa falu hisea yama amamina yafena nagaya tusia muse ani yafena nehuna naipamoa falu huno kanale nehie.
Filemonia Onesimusina avalenageno fatago huno nefu maisie.

Nagaya ma nagesa nehavue nago kavala fatago yama hisana yana hanegi havio. Yisasi Kalaisiene ailokaena mainena tokiyaage kefiti Ani kavala huo. huna huleasinagi nahau nayamopafima nahaiya yafene huna yuna kelegati kahavi-negoe. E, nagaya Polona kosuna mainogeyagi Yisasi Kalaisi kema hua yateti navaleya kina hunatagena mainena mage huna kahavi-negoe.
Kagaya Filemoniga nagai nafanea Onesimusina Kahau huto. huna kahavi-negoe. Nagaya nofipi mainena Yisasife havino agupi malesia yafe hapaugeno havino agupi malenea yafe nagai nafane maine.
Nayona kanaleya huno aliyakaa oalinegi menia kagaiene nagaienena taayama hisia aliyana kanaleya huno menia aligahie.
Nagaya menia kagaitega etena hutogeno nevianagino name-kafamoa agaiene nevie.
Yisasi Kalaisifena kanale mono kema humainoa yateti nofipi mainoanagina Onesimusina atafa hisugeno nagaiene maineno kagai anonaa nahamaesie huna nehue.
Nehuanagi kagayama ani augafa kavafema E. huka ohisanagena agaifena Ouka male maiyo. huna ohuleasinagi kagayama nagaiene maisia yafe nenahaiye hukama hisanana kanalele.
Nagesa havuana eteno kagaiene agola maisia yafe osi kana kanoa Onesimusia kataleno umaine.

Umaineanagino nahau nayamopafi nenahaiya kanogino menia nofipi maineno miya oali aliya kanokaamoke omainegi Nahaiya nenafu maine huka nagua amisua aliya kano maine. huka kagesa havi neamika Yisasina agua aminea kano maine. huka nagoene kagua amigane.
Kagayama nagaifena Yisasi Kalaisi aliyate tokaetaa nealua nenafue. huka kagesama havinukahena nagaima navalesana avamete huka Onesimusina avalo.
Nagola havi yama hugateteno anonaama eteno kamisia yama omalesigekahena agai agia neataleka nagai nagile kaemalo.

Nagaya Polona nagainia nayapiti mani avona kae-maletena nagainia agai kemo anonaa negamue. Tamage Yisasi kema kahapai-mainoa keleti kagu kamena aligatea yafema havika namisana anonaama haneanagika ani yana Namio. huna kahavi-okegahue.
E, nenafugae Anumayamoene ailokaetaa mainoa yafe ani kavama hisanagena muse hisugeno naipamoa kanale hugahie. Afaa ani kavala hunato.
Kahapauva kema akave malesanana nagoene kahapauva kemona agaseno kanale yana hutegane huna nagesa havina mani avona kaena negamue.
Nago kene hanegi nagaya faesua nonia talo tala hunato. Anumaya Kotitega nagaifema havigana kema haviteno hunatesigena tamakaitega ugahue huna nametiti huna mainoe.
Poloene aliya nealiya nefuya Filemonina hu falu fala hutenaya ke.
Epafalasia Yisasi Kalaisi kea humainoa yafe nagaiene kina nopi mainea kanomoa Mainano? huno hu falu fala hugate.
Makiene Alisatakusiene Temasiene Lukuene nagaiene aliya nealiya vayamoya ania huya hu falu fala hugatae.
Anumayatimoa Yisasi Kalaisi kayone hulamatesia yamaamoa tamakaiene hanege hanege huno hanesie.
